description: Great Expectations validation-result metadata connector (Tier-3, no-row-data). Reads GX validation-result JSON artefacts written by CI runs from a configured local directory and indexes the validation METADATA per expectation — suite name, batch id, expectation type, column, success/failure, the aggregate observed value (a count/fraction/mean metric), element and unexpected counts, and run time. It NEVER reads or indexes the failing-data SAMPLES (unexpected_list / partial_unexpected_list / partial_unexpected_index_list / unexpected_index_list / partial_unexpected_counts) — those carry real data cell values (row data) and are stripped on read. No network, no live credentials. Read-only; no write tools.
author: Nimbus
